==Monthly releases==
[[File:Electric Pikachu Boogaloo issue 1.png|thumb|Issue #1]]
Just like the first two volumes, Electric Pikachu Boogaloo was released by [[VIZ Media]] as [[List of Electric Tale of Pikachu monthly issues|four monthly issues]] containing one to two chapters each, comprising the entire volume collectively, which was released separately. These monthly comic book issues were released from July 23, through October 22, 1999. As a bonus, these monthly releases each contained fan letters and fan artwork which were not included in the regular volume releases. 

The following monthly comic book issues were released:
* [[Electric Pikachu Boogaloo issue 1|Issue 1]]
